newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 15.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
The Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference urges full support for a Communist Party resolution issued on Sunday and hailed as a blueprint for building a socialist society.
China plans to launch a national campaign to check tax collection, financing activities and prices in a drive to improve financial and economic order.
Top legislator Qiao Shi says China supports efforts to resolve problems facing the Middle East peace process through political negotiations in line with the "land for peace" principle.
China had a trade surplus of $3.13 billion in September, customs figures show. Exports were $13.42 billion while imports were 10.29 billion.
